claims.statement: For all n>=1 and nonempty R subseteq [n], every restriction of F_{n,R}(z,x)=(-1)^{z sum_{j in R} x_j}(1-2 1_{x=0}), every parity-shifted defect boundary, every affine-quadratic phase, and every disjoint product of these blocks satisfies G(f)<=14 I(f).
claims.quantifiers: All dimensions; all 1<=|R|<=n; unbounded inactive-coordinate count, disjoint quadratic rank and total dimension; genuine uniform-cube Boolean signs; base-2 units.

claims.statement: On the same restriction-closed class, U(f)<=14 I(f) and H(f)<=30 I(f).
claims.scope_note: Proper expanding class only; this does not settle full FEI.

claims.statement: No dimension-independent control of the aggregate upper-set asymmetry mismatch is proved for arbitrary changing coherent cores with reused physical variables.
claims.delta: The gap is removed for one partial quadratic-star centre sharing a point defect, including arbitrarily many inactive defect coordinates, but not for two overlapping centres or arbitrary hierarchies.
